# Decap CMS

> Decap CMS is a single-page app that gives editors a Git-backed content
> editing UI for static sites. Config is a YAML file describing collections
> and fields; the app is mounted at `/admin` on the target site. Full,
> up-to-date docs live at https://www.decapcms.org/ — this repo's Markdown
> files (linked below) cover package internals, widget options, and backend
> setup that ship alongside the code.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, install methods (CDN quick start vs. npm build), and links to decapcms.org.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Monorepo setup, available npm scripts (`build`, `test`, `test:e2e`), and PR conventions.
- [packages/decap-cms/README.md](packages/decap-cms/README.md): The all-in-one `decap-cms` package most sites install.
- [packages/decap-cms-app/README.md](packages/decap-cms-app/README.md): The `decap-cms-app` package for extension-based (a la carte widget/backend) installs.
- [packages/decap-server/README.md](packages/decap-server/README.md): Local proxy server used for git-gateway-free local development.

## Widgets

- [Boolean](packages/decap-cms-widget-boolean/README.md): Switch-style toggle control for boolean values.
- [Code](packages/decap-cms-widget-code/README.md): CodeMirror-based syntax-highlighted code editor.
- [Color](packages/decap-cms-widget-colorstring/README.md): Color picker producing a hex or `rgba()` string.
- [DateTime](packages/decap-cms-widget-datetime/README.md): Native date/time picker producing a formatted datetime string.
- [File](packages/decap-cms-widget-file/README.md): Upload or select a file from the configured media library.
- [Image](packages/decap-cms-widget-image/README.md): Upload or select an image from the configured media library.
- [List](packages/decap-cms-widget-list/README.md): Repeatable list of values or nested field sets.
- [Map](packages/decap-cms-widget-map/README.md): OpenLayers map for drawing a point/line/polygon, stored as GeoJSON.
- [Number](packages/decap-cms-widget-number/README.md): Numeric input with min/max/step/value-type options.
- [Object](packages/decap-cms-widget-object/README.md): Group multiple fields as one nested field, with i18n support.
- [Relation](packages/decap-cms-widget-relation/README.md): Reference an entry from another collection or file.
- [Rich Text](packages/decap-cms-widget-richtext/README.md): WYSIWYG Markdown editor with a raw-Markdown mode.
- [Select](packages/decap-cms-widget-select/README.md): Dropdown selection from a list of options.

## Backends

- [GitHub](packages/decap-cms-backend-github/README.md): Abstraction layer between the CMS and the GitHub REST API.
- [GitLab](packages/decap-cms-backend-gitlab/README.md): Abstraction layer between the CMS and the GitLab API.
- [Bitbucket](packages/decap-cms-backend-bitbucket/README.md): Abstraction layer between the CMS and the Bitbucket REST API.
- [Azure DevOps](packages/decap-cms-backend-azure/README.md): Abstraction layer between the CMS and Azure DevOps Git.
- [Gitea](packages/decap-cms-backend-gitea/README.md): Abstraction layer between the CMS and the Gitea REST API.
- [Git Gateway](packages/decap-cms-backend-git-gateway/README.md): Netlify's gateway to hosted git APIs, for identity-based auth without exposing git host tokens.
- [AWS Cognito + GitHub Proxy](packages/decap-cms-backend-aws-cognito-github-proxy/README.md): GitHub backend proxied through AWS Cognito for auth.
- [Proxy backend](packages/decap-cms-backend-proxy/README.md): Talks to `decap-server` for local development without a real git backend.

## Auth and shared libraries

- [Lib Auth](packages/decap-cms-lib-auth/README.md): Shared OAuth and implicit-flow authentication helpers used by backends.
- [Lib Util](packages/decap-cms-lib-util/README.md): Shared utilities used across `decap-cms-backend-*` packages.
- [UI Auth](packages/decap-cms-ui-auth/README.md): Shared authentication UI pages used by backend packages.
- [Locales](packages/decap-cms-locales/README.md): Bundled UI translations; English is the default.

## Media libraries

- [Cloudinary](packages/decap-cms-media-library-cloudinary/README.md): Cloudinary integration replacing the built-in media library.
- [Uploadcare](packages/decap-cms-media-library-uploadcare/README.md): Uploadcare integration replacing the built-in media library.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): This same index with the full Markdown content of every linked doc inlined, generated by `npm run docs:llms`.
